notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
――A story of warmth, quiet, and kindness beneath the silent snow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/b7765a69f7a09ab132eae8e73ffd00849e5c7536.png[/img]
[h2]🎨【Major UI Update】[/h2]
We've completely revamped the game UI to deepen your immersion in the story.
The new design captures the texture of cold and the gentle warmth of human connection, creating a serene and atmospheric experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/75d884080aac8bcd2810c7df94cd7fb8b4b5b8c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/a915262f7f21aa6d34cc3d043092a578bd910141.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/5ee13272d4daf37f3ceb610c8bf41b85797e6b1f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/53de37ba191d6a51b4a4218d8a54c42e80812f6d.png[/img]
[h3]UI[/h3]
We’re grateful to ryllis from monoryllis for her collaboration.
https://monoryllis.com/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/d9932ad52b59edee0cec4b88f8f341459eb64a66.png[/img]

[h2]👘【Character Art Update】[/h2]
We've updated the default standing portrait of one of our player character, Isbrand.
With their long hair now tied up, this new look gently reveals a different side of them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/513bb30316212ebe7888a1de6bd04417a5f8b176.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194272/d9932ad52b59edee0cec4b88f8f341459eb64a66.png[/img]

📅 Scheduled for release in Winter 2026.
▶️ Please consider adding Thaw to your wishlist!

🌙❄️ From the developer of the mining-themed visual novel Thaw ❄️
